caption: The video captures a hand-modeled clay figure shaped like an ice-cream cone, standing upright near the center of a pale wood-grain tabletop under dim, even lighting. The scoop is a lumpy dark-gray mass with a yellow swirl through its middle and a glossy highlight on the top dome, while gray and yellow bits hang over the rim of the gray cone cup. The cone remains upright and centered, with no obvious tipping or sliding. At the lower right of the base a small dark-gray mark on the table gradually changes outline, thickening from a thin streak into a more rounded patch. A faint yellow speck also becomes distinguishable on the tabletop left of the base, while the cone's lumpy surface otherwise stays largely unchanged. These quiet surface changes continue without the figure losing balance or rearranging its mass.
